_comment: The index's own gates that read every mounted layer, judged on every layer PR with its head swapped into the index (cat-harness-tools: index checks in layer CI). Each broke the index at re-pin time after the layer's own PR passed: check:reference-direction:check (folio-assistant-core#630, cat-harness-tools#1445: a doc comment naming a layer above), check:prov-qaqc (cat-harness-tools#1417: cat-harness's committed PROV logs went stale), and the generated-file checks over every layer's committed output. Gate name (`<declaring instance>:<script>`, the name run-gates.py gives a declared gate) -> the script, run as `bun run cat <script>` from the root. run-gates.py runs them for EVERY caller, under these names, whether or not its dependency harness includes the declaring instance; pr-tests.yml runs them through run-root-gates.py, one at a time after the pooled gates. Both judge them error by error (gate_diagnostics.py), so a gate already red on main fails only the PR that adds a finding to it.
